headline: TJX (TJX) Stock Looks Rich As Earnings Expectations Do The Heavy Lifting
summary: TJX Companies stock has delivered strong long term returns over the past five years, yet the current market multiples and valuation checks suggest the shares are pricing in a full outlook rather than offering a clear bargain. Over the past 5 years, TJX Companies has returned 145.3%, which puts extra focus on whether the current share price already reflects much of that success.
